# Third-party components

| Path | Component | Licence |
|------|-----------|---------|
| `tesseract/` | tesseract.js 5.1.1 (https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js) | Apache-2.0, see `tesseract/LICENSE.md` |
| `core/` | tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core) | Apache-2.0, see `core/LICENSE` |
| `lang/eng.traineddata.gz` | Tesseract English model (https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata) | Apache-2.0 |
| `lang/chi_sim.traineddata.gz` | Tesseract Simplified Chinese model, 4.0.0 best_int build from the `@tesseract.js-data/chi_sim` package (https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best) | Apache-2.0 |
